notes: Reference numbers come from real training logs (torch 2.2.2, transformers 4.x, data loading included, bf16 autocast, AdamW, grad clip 1.0, strict deterministic algorithms with CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, TF32 off for matmuls and cuDNN convolutions, flash attention off for clips longer than 4 s, LayerDrop 0, activation checkpointing off, 2 spawn DataLoader workers unless noted). They are not runs of this benchmark; the benchmark's e2e.w2v2b.6s.bs16.bf16 and e2e.xlsr.6s.bs16.bf16 rows use the same numerics and loader setup. agbench_runs will hold exact numbers from this benchmark on the same GPUs later.
